name: ka_auto_cdn_first_seen
why: AUTO-TRIAGE row (tier-1 phase A gate): a first-seen CDN edge, 0/94 engines.
The model must reach false_positive/benign and STAGE the close. Authorizing the
close is the autonomy policy's job: under the default shadow policy the staged
close waits in the Monitor as a one-click approval (needs_human), and runs
unattended only once the close-false-positive rule is promoted to enforce -- so
the queue holds a ready-to-approve close, not a re-investigation.
